notes.title: 1st level glitch fixed
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay everyone. I know it's been a while but for some odd reason, I have never received any emails regarding this glitch that occurred on the 1st level of this game. Since it's been a while since the release, I have moved on to other things. I just recently received an email regarding the glitch in level 1. I went back and tested this version and the one from Nutaku. The version from Nutaku was working perfectly fine but for some odd reason, the steam version had the glitch. I'm only now getting emails after 10 months. 

So I uploaded the version that's working perfectly fine. Now you should be able to bypass level 1. I have tested the whole game all day and it's working without any issues. 

If there are more bugs, please email me at newastudios@gmail.com

Once again, I do apologize for this glitch and thanks for those that emailed me directly since I don't receive any email updates from the message boards.

notes.title: The finished game is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Yes, I know, earlier than expected but after many days of designing and testing, the full version is now live!  This doesn't mean its fully completed. I will continue to add more features such as mini games in the near future. For those who already purchased the early access, make sure you update the application version to the latest one. I hope we get more feedback! Unfortunately I do not get any notification when someone posts something in the discussion forum but I do my best to check it. 

Also, the game engine I am currently using is having issues with controller support but I am working with the company team to see if there are any solutions to it.

notes.title: Stage 5 completed! Final update until full release.
notes.notes:
This will be the final update before the release of the full version next month. The early access now has 5 playable stages. 

I will keep posting updates here in the discussion board as I finish the next stages and will announce when the full version will be officially released.
